title: Base-degree lift for a free complex
statement: For a commutative ring R, modules M,N, a map φ : M ⟶ N, an augmentation η : N' 0 ⟶ N that is surjective, a family F, and π : F 0 ⟶ M with F 0 free, there exists a₀ : F 0 ⟶ N' 0 such that a₀ ≫ η = π ≫ φ.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00LS, proof of lemma-compare-resolutions (1), lines 17525--17535

proof.text: Use that a free module is projective and apply Module.projective_lifting_property to the surjective augmentation and the composite φ ∘ π; package the lifted linear map as a ModuleCat morphism.
